notes: Another way to get songs into your library: add a streamed song to an album you already have, and it joins that album without being downloaded first.

On a laptop the page now sizes itself for the screen: bigger text, list rows that keep to a comfortable width instead of spanning the whole window, and a player that floats over the page instead of gluing itself to the bottom and both edges.
The home wall stops stretching its bubbles across a wide window, and song menus, sheets and dialogs get more room and larger type - so nothing on a laptop is cramped, stretched or hard to see.
